motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: The single authored moment: views fade and rise 10px on mount.

label.purpose: Status lines and table headers, letterspaced.

mono.purpose: IDs, values, diffs, packets. Data only.

dos: Do keep exactly one filled button on any visible screen.
Do render IDs, values, diffs, and packets in 13px system mono.
Do theme selection (accent tint) and focus rings (2px accent, 3px offset) from the palette.
donts: Don't put the accent on anything except the primary action.
Don't enclose content in bordered cards or tinted panels.
Don't use emoji, unicode arrows, or glyph icons — draw 1.5px SVG.
Don't add shadows, gradients, kickers above headings, or colored edge borders.
Don't ship a screen with two competing primary actions; demote to a disclosure.
keyCharacteristics: One screen, one verdict, one filled button.
The accent appears exactly once per screen, on the primary action.
narrative.overview: The interface behaves like a well-made tool left on a clean desk: white ground, hairline divisions, one blue reserved for the single thing you can do. Nothing glows, nothing shouts, nothing competes with the verdict.

rules.body: The accent blue is used on exactly one control per screen: the primary action. Secondary tools are quiet text in a darker pressed blue (#0068d1) that holds 4.5:1 on white.
rules.name: The One Voice Rule

rules.body: Content is separated by 1px hairlines, never enclosed in bordered cards or tinted panels.
rules.name: The No Boxes Rule

rules.body: No webfonts, no serifs, no display faces. The tool speaks in the operating system's voice.
rules.name: The System Voice Rule
